$comment: Closing CTA card — the last thing on the homepage before the brand statement and footer. One ACF group: `pills` and `trust` are repeaters, `primary`/`secondary` are link fields. A href starting http(s) opens in a new tab; a href ending .pdf is served as a download from public/downloads (see that folder's README). Keep `headline` to one short line and `headlineAccent` to one — they are set at display size and a third line pushes the buttons below the fold on a laptop.
